description: Elections Commission - Declare that Varneswary Raviehandran as a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a seat that became vacant. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
